title: Coefficient components fit a polynomial budget
statement: Let a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input have dimension $n>0$, rational accuracy $a/b$ with $a>0$ and $2a\le b$, and Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Let $P$ be the polynomial budget associated with its coefficient input. The deterministic small-bias construction work at the associated generator parameters, the associated sample count, and the local Fourier-estimation work over all $n$ coordinates are each at most $P$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
